 AUDIO: Sunscreen changes flagged for Australia
 NewsRadio
 Posted Tue 27 Oct 2026 at 10:19am Tue 27 Oct 2026 at 10:19am Tue 27 Oct 2026 at 10:19am Has Audio Duration: 7 minutes 53 seconds . Listen 7 m Consumer group CHOICE says the TGA's announcement highlights the need for changes to how sunscreens are regulated and tested in Australia. ( Adobe Stock ) 
 Share options Facebook 
 LinkedIn 
 X (formerly Twitter) 
 The Therapeutic Goods Administration has released the details of its proposed sweeping reforms to the sunscreen industry. Last year, Consumer Advocacy group CHOICE tested 20 popular SPF 50 sunscreens and found 16 of those sunscreens did NOT meet their advertised rating.
 Dr Laura Dawes, is an expert in medicine and law at the Australian National University. She explains to NewsRadio's Sarah Morice exactly what's included in these reforms.
